name: Double Minor

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A 2.00 graduation grade point average (GPA) and upper division GPA is required.

sections.note:
With the exception of EDUC 401, 402, 403, 405 and 406, courses completed in any faculty may be used to satisfy degree requirements, but course admission is subject to the prerequisites of various departments.
Additional requirements are satisfied through completion of the double minor option, as specified below.
Note: EDUC 100W, EDUC 252 and EDUC 352W must be completed before starting the Professional Development Program (PDP).

sections.title: Double Minor Option

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In addition to the courses specified above, students also complete two minors or extended minors, one of which must be a Faculty of Education minor, as shown below.

sections.note:
Social Justice in Education
Counselling and Human Development Minor Program
Curriculum and Instruction Minor Program
Early Learning Minor Program
Educational Psychology Minor Program
Elementary Generalist Minor Program
Environmental Education Minor Program
French Education Minor Program
International and Global Education Minor Program
Learning and Developmental Disabilities Minor Program
Physical and Health Education Minor Program
Secondary Mathematics Education Minor Program
Secondary Teaching Minor Program

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
